# Email sharing recurring drafts and reminders

- Use Resend with an explicit send action, editable preview/recipients/CC/reply-to/message and the exact issued PDF. Development checks use synthetic data and mocked delivery or an explicitly designated test recipient.
- Persist send attempts and use idempotency with safe retries. Verify webhook signatures and tolerate duplicate/out-of-order delivery events.
- Public viewing/download links require unguessable scoped tokens, optional expiry, immediate revocation and no-index pages. They must not expose other records.
- Recurring schedules create reviewable drafts; handle month-end, timezone, pause and repeated execution without duplicates.
- Automated reminders default off. When enabled, recheck balance before sending and respect paid/void state, bounced recipients and paused follow-ups.
- Use scheduled/queued work within the same Worker architecture where needed. Do not equate accepted email with delivered email.
